reason: The blank is real, but the stated mechanism is wrong. BSE's own shareholding index DOES list SMR's one pattern: qtr '04 Jun 2026', filed 2026-06-08, XbrlFile 544774_86202616343_SHP.xml. This is the pre-listing, IPO-time SHP, which BSE dates to the day. bse_provider._shp_quarter_end parses only 'Month YYYY'. It returns None for the three-token '04 Jun 2026' (verified in the sidecar venv), and corporate_disclosures._bse_shareholding then silently skips a row with no quarter_end. The service goes on to report 'every applicable lane was reachable but carried no pattern' as an honest-looking count=0. That is not a filing-venue gap. It is a parser that drops the day-dated listing-time SHP, which is the only pattern every fresh IPO has. Severity stays high. Besides the agent disclosure tool, the research ownership_check that would challenge yfinance's 78.56% 'insiders' with the exchange promoter figure (65.74% per the pack) has no witness, so the unchallenged number stands. Also, count=0 falsely asserts that no pattern exists. Fix: accept 'DD Mon YYYY' in _shp_quarter_end, or fall back to filing_date, and never drop a row with a filed XBRL.

reason: The value is wrong, and the mechanism is now pinned down. eps=5.58 is yfinance info['trailingEps'], passed straight through and stamped status 'ok'. It equals SMR.BO's FY2025 (year to 2025-03-31) Basic EPS exactly: 104,123,000 / 18,653,743 = 5.5819. Yahoo has not ingested FY2026: its annual statements stop at 2025-03-31. Meanwhile netIncomeToCommon (247,484,992) in the same payload is FY2026. So the headline EPS is a full fiscal year stale, not 'differently scoped'. P/E (17.0 on 19 Sep, 17.47 on 23 Sep) is Yahoo's trailingPE on that stale EPS, about 2.4-3x the outside 5.6-7.2x (reported EPS 16.89) and the app's own 13.27. The correctness gate only checks that pe x eps sits inside the 52-week band (95 does), so the stale pair passes. Unlike DAT-P3-2 and DAT-P6-2, this is no weighted-vs-period-end basis difference: no reading of FY2026 gives 5.58. High stands: a wrong valuation input shown as true.

reason: Real: the resolve and fundamentals payloads carry no board/SME or face-value field. The mechanism and fix shape are wrong. The board fact is already in the app's bundled BSE master: the SMR row is ['544774','SMR','SMR Jewels Ltd','MT',...], where group MT marks SME trade-for-trade. The resolver reads that group column and discards it (_group) at every use, and the resolve payload has no board key. So the fix is to project a field the resolver already loads, not to ingest ComHeader (which, per DAT-P16-6, is used only by the offline sector-regeneration script). The face_value leg alone would be low (DAT-P7-6, DAT-P16-6). Medium holds here for the board leg: for an SME name with a 2,000-share lot and trade-for-trade settlement, a missing SME label hides a decision-relevant risk, which is the case DAT-P13-1 said should be scored higher.
